# StereoKit

> StereoKit is a lightweight, low-dependency C# library for XR apps and games built on OpenXR.

## Docs

- [API reference](https://stereokit.net/preview/StereoKit-docs-API.md): every type, with class-qualified signatures, summaries, and parameters.
- [Guides & examples](https://stereokit.net/preview/StereoKit-docs-reference.md): conceptual guides and runnable C# samples, one section per API member.

## Optional

- [Website](https://stereokit.net/preview): full human-facing documentation, guides, and screenshots.
